stem:
Sameer reads a bar chart titled "Favourite fruit in Class 7B, 2025 school survey of $36$ students." Mango has the tallest bar.

Which two claims correctly limit what the display allows him to conclude?

options.text: The bars report Class 7B survey choices in $2025$; they do not by themselves prove why mango is most popular.
Treat the bars as nationwide fruit facts for every class, with no use of the Class 7B $2025$ survey source.
Among the $36$ Class 7B students surveyed, mango received the most votes shown on the chart.
Mango causes more students to join Class 7B.

teacher.key_rationale: The chart supports Class 7B 2025 survey tallies and that mango has the tallest bar. Stretching to nationwide facts or claiming mango causes class joins exceeds what the collection method allows.
